newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yield steady, 6-mo yield falls.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yield steady, 6-mo yield falls.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.25 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 4, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 31.584 million UAG 6.399 million UAG
Actual amount raised 27.639 million UAG 5.999 million UAG
Ukraine's central bank sold 315,847 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 97,225 were competitive and 218,622 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for September 11.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills fell to 59.50 percent against 62.29 percent at the last sale on September 5, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 2.866 million UAG 34.194 million UAG
Actual amount raised 2.210 million UAG 26.089 million UAG
The central bank sold 28,661 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 4,400 were competitive and 24,261 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for September 11.
A central bank official said the Finance Ministry cancelled auctions of nine-month and 12-month T-bills that were also sheduled for September 10.
